mfa.label: Two-factor authentication (MFA)
mfa.setupDescription: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy...) then enter the 6-digit code it generates.

adminReset.description: This removes the two-factor authentication of {{name}} and signs them out of every device. They will have to set it up again at their next sign-in.
adminReset.descriptionLocked: The two-factor authentication of {{name}} is currently locked after too many wrong codes. This removes it, lifts the lock and signs them out of every device. They will have to set it up again at their next sign-in.

resendCode.title: Resend the verification code
resendCode.description: Sends a new code by SMS to {{phone}}. The member types it in the app to confirm their number.
resendCode.unavailable: The number is already verified or missing: there is no code to resend.

changeContact.title: Change the phone number or email
changeContact.description: Only use this after checking the member's identity. The new contact counts as verified and the member is signed out of every device.

changeCountry.title: Change the account's country
changeCountry.description: The account currently belongs to: {{country}}. The country sets the currency of the rides published, the SMS provider and the languages offered. Rides and bookings already made keep their country.

resetPassword.title: Reset the password
resetPassword.description: Sends the member the reset code, by SMS to their verified number (or by email if there is none). They choose their new password themselves in the app. If the member asks for a code again from the app, only the last code sent is valid.
resetPassword.unavailable: The member has no verified phone number and no email: change their contact first.
